intent: IMPLEMENT SequencingService so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing use case implementing SequenceTelemetryUseCase. Constructor SequencingService(Duration reorderWindow, int reorderBufferCapacity, Duration windowSize, Duration windowSlide, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> sequencedSamples, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent> backfillDetections, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryWindowClosedEvent> closedWindows). Keeps a ReorderWindow and SlidingWindowAssembler per deviceId (ConcurrentHashMap, per-device serialization). On each sample: BACKFILL -> publish TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample,false) and buffer; LATE -> publish TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample,true) only; then every drained sample is published in t_device order as TelemetrySampleSequenced and fed to the assembler whose closed windows are published as TelemetryWindowClosed. flush() drains all and closes windows. Never revalidates. Overflow errors propagate (backpressure).
